sections.title: General Info
sections.description: Capture cards and steal stacks. Finish with the most cards.

sections.title: Cards
body: Face cards match only their own rank.
Stacks belong to players and can be stolen.

sections.title: Game Rules
body: On your turn, play one card from your hand.
If your card matches a card on the table, you capture it.
If your card matches another player's stack value, you steal that stack.
If no capture or steal is possible, the card stays on the table.
Players continue taking turns until all cards are played.

sections.title: Stealing Stacks
body: Player stacks remain vulnerable to stealing.
A matching card can take ownership of an opponent’s stack.
Large stacks are valuable but can attract attention.

sections.title: Winning the Round
body: When the round ends, players count their captured cards.
The player with the most cards wins the round.
Winning multiple steals can make the difference.

sections.title: Strategy Tips
body: Pay attention to cards already played.
Sometimes saving a card for a steal is better than capturing immediately.
